dedupe_keys.name: physical condition of government owned or supported facilities alberta

description: The statistic uses a five-year extended Facility Condition Index to compare health facilities, schools, post-secondary institutions and government-owned facilities. The index divides the cost of current and future five-year maintenance needs by facility replacement value. Good/fair/poor shares are calculated by floor area within each facility type. Native coverage is April 2011–March 2015, with CSV and PDF descriptors. These are asset-condition and maintenance-cost observations. Numerical rating thresholds, individual building identities and the actual values are not provided in the descriptive metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
